purpose: Procurement composition companions for the built-in Dynamic UI runtime.

system_boundary.companion_role: Composition reference only. It may alter proportion, alignment, visual rhythm, and support-block placement inside an allowed built-in material; it is not a template, component library, widget payload, or runtime asset.
system_boundary.color_mapping: Map the selected HTML --accent to built-in --brand or the primary chart series, map HTML neutrals to built-in surface/text/border roles, and use HTML --accent2 only for its verified exception or reversal meaning. Do not create local palette aliases.
system_boundary.surface_mapping: Keep cards, metric blocks, tables, and chart panels on built-in neutral surface roles in both host themes; route color belongs in data marks, inset badges, focal text, or a deliberately full bounded reversal.
system_boundary.outer_widget_width: Fill the available chat width; constrain only an inner polar or mechanism visual when the built-in contract requires it.
system_boundary.frame_rule: All card and panel borders remain complete and neutral. Never use a colored single-edge strip or an accent-color frame; use inset badges, text, whole chart marks, or a full bounded reversal instead. Preserve keyboard visibility with a complete high-contrast neutral focus outline or neutral full-frame border.

layout_families.label: Award frontier
layout_families.composition: A dominant two-axis plot takes about two thirds of the width; a compact ranked register or two-option comparison occupies the remaining column. Keep the recommendation in a direct chart mark or inset badge, never in analysis prose inside the widget.
layout_families.interaction: Hover or keyboard focus inspects a supplier; click or tap locks the same supplier across plot and register.

layout_families.label: Price pulse
layout_families.composition: Use one full-width trend or grouped comparison as the dominant row. Add one compact aligned driver strip below or at the right only when it answers a second evidence question; never place two large charts side by side.
layout_families.interaction: Hover or focus reveals exact period and basis; click or tap may lock one period or switch benchmark series.

layout_families.label: Risk lens
layout_families.composition: A scan-first matrix or bounded profile occupies the primary field; a narrow evidence or gate register aligns to the same rows. Use words, symbols, or intensity marks rather than a color-per-status card system.
layout_families.interaction: Hover or keyboard focus inspects a cell or dimension; click or tap locks one risk level, supplier, or evidence state.

layout_families.label: Exception queue
layout_families.composition: Use a ranked exception rail with one expanded focal row or a compact schedule with a subordinate queue. Limit the visible peers to four and keep dates, units, and missing values explicit.
layout_families.interaction: Hover or focus previews an exception; click or tap pins one item and reveals its date, trigger, or evidence row.

layout_families.label: Landed flow
layout_families.composition: Use one left-to-right route or cost-build field with a compact totals register. Weighted ribbons require real non-negative weights; otherwise use bars, a scatter, or a simple node flow.
layout_families.interaction: Hover or keyboard focus traces one lane or cost component; click or tap locks its path and linked total.

layout_families.label: Execution track
layout_families.composition: Use a three-to-five-step track, compact schedule, or owner handoff with one focal gate. Keep connectors neutral except for one primary path and keep all labels within the planned geometry.
layout_families.interaction: Hover or focus inspects one gate or task; click or tap locks the step and its owner, due date, or fallback.

routes.composition_transform: Hard ledger grid, exact alignment, asymmetric 62/38 evidence splits, thin neutral rules, and compact tabular registers. Keep at least one open field rather than boxing every fact.
One generous focal stage with one or two named supporting objects, pronounced scale contrast, large gaps, and only one raised plane.
Editorial act changes, oversized labels, horizontal docket rows, and deliberate light/dark reversals; avoid a repeating card grid.
Strict monochrome grid, line-weight hierarchy, audit indices, hatched data marks, and card-free evidence wherever possible.
Pure-white field, irregular modular spans, one chartreuse focal block, black comparison anchors, compact condensed labels, and neutral outlined peers.
Near-black editorial field, offset emerald modules, cyan primary data, yellow reversal only, large numbered acts, and explicit high-contrast light text.
